# discord_media_channel (List Resource)

Lists the media channels of a server. Starting November 16, 2026, Discord omits channels the bot cannot view.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_media_channel" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list media channels of.
